title: Sabri woo rookak tayseh
intro: Sabri kaak aydaadu yekkeh yan idaltu, mabla kaak rookaak raddeeh, uxih qibaadah ekraarol leh yan imaan qigdu maqambaala. Tama num taban kee namma lab baxi kedoodah rakiibo fan dadaltam yubleeh, kaxxaam kicna awkak biyak le taqabi kataaseeh, kaxxa rooka foocal qaxmeqe sabrih wakti sinni asta yekke. massakaxxa le rooci kay aydaadu warseh galitteh maybalaalaqa. Atu tama muuci Qur'aanak baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu farmoytak suge kay aydaadi Qur'aanak lafale suurah addat addatino luk warse.
Anu taban kee namma baxa luk sugeeh, Bani Israa-eel kedoodah abbobti yekken.
Anu inni baxah baxaabaxsale albaabitte fan culaanam warseh, oson dubuk yan mara akkuk yamixxige waanama.
yi intiita qaddowteh soole sinni weeqak kiciyyo awkak yok beenih.
Anu qaago garuq cineh walaa yi gersi xaylo yoo kassisse wak, Anu dubuk Yalla malkitah exceh.
Anu Yuusuf nabiyyih abba kinniyo, kay migaq Qarab afat 'the augmenter' yaanama.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
